excluded.volume: global performance volume; not reset on load, so load-order dependent (Appendix A.4)
excluded.fx_bypass: global performance setting; not reset on load
excluded.polylimit: polyphony limit, no effect on a single note; not reset on load
excluded.scene_active: used to pick the active scene, not a feature
excluded.scenemode: always single in the kept set
excluded.fx_disable: bitmask, used for the FX masks instead of as a feature
excluded.scene/pbrange_dn: pitch-bend range, no effect on a held note
excluded.scene/pbrange_up: pitch-bend range, no effect on a held note
excluded.scene/send_level: moved into the FX blocks (send_level of the FX that sits on that send)
excluded.fx/airwindows: not available in the Rack build (Section 10), sub-algorithm list is its own world

notes.fx_position: fx/<type>/position = index of the slot within its group of 4 (insert: A1-A4, send: send 1-4, global: G1-G4) = chain order
notes.masks: levels and sends count as > 0 if their base value is > 0 OR they are a modulation destination; osc: audible, ring-mod or FM modulator; lfo: has a routing from it in the active scene; filter params: type != none; waveshaper drive: type != none; noise colour: noise audible; fm_depth: FM on; fx: heard (not off/disabled; insert of the active scene, global, or send with send and return level > 0)
